name: resolvepay-root
description: ResolvePay Rescue — Autonomous commerce dispute and remedy resolution platform

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres && pnpm dev:api
scripts.apimatic:sdks: apimatic sdk generate -l typescript -d apimatic/sdks/typescript --force -i apimatic && apimatic sdk generate -l python -d apimatic/sdks/python --force -i apimatic && apimatic sdk generate -l csharp -d apimatic/sdks/csharp --force -i apimatic
scripts.apimatic:all: pnpm openapi:export && pnpm apimatic:validate && pnpm apimatic:portal && pnpm apimatic:sdks && pnpm apimatic:plugin
